{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1].index

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f'Duplicate patient_ids: {duplicate_count}')

# Check if any patient has multiple sample_seq values
sample_seq_max = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(sample_seq_max[sample_seq_max > 1])}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline}')

# Check for missing values in arm, severity, responded
missing_arm = data['arm'].isna().sum()
missing_severity = data['severity'].isna().sum()
missing_responded = data['responded'].isna().sum()

print(f'Missing values in arm: {missing_arm}')
print(f'Missing values in severity: {missing_severity}')
print(f'Missing values in responded: {missing_responded}')"}
